  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION

  BTech V Semester - Make up Examination, Jan - 2025  
  ADVANCED COMPUTER NETWORKS [CSE-5151]  
  Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Compare and contrast the challenges and issues in UAV network.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the multi-UAV network for the case of COVID-19.                                  (4)  
  C)      Summarize the applications of UAVs.                                                      (2)  
  2)           Explain the architecture of Software Defined Network (SDN) with a neat diagram.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the working of Cisco-ACI APIC controller.                                        (4)  
  C)      With suitable example explain the network virtualization components.                     (2)  
  3)           Discuss the components ACI in designing as an open system.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the relationship between SDS and HCI.                                            (4)  
  C)      Compare block and file storage.                                                          (2)  
  4)           Interpret the various types of VoIP playout delays with suitable examples.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain step by step procedure connect where jim@umass.edu calls keith@poly.edu for  
  SIP.                                                                                (4)  
  
  C)      Illustrate how in Skype networks peers relay provides solution to the problem of "NAT  
  prevents outside peer from initiating connection to insider peer".                       (2)
